designDecisions.decision: TWO boards: Main (template-city) and Connected (bastrop_tx). No third.
designDecisions.argument: an unconnected-city board would redraw the sentence _design/smartcity-public-works-lens/Empty.dc.html already draws, which is the reason Fire and EMS cut its third. A separate 'what this is not' board would restate the two basis lines Main already carries under their panels. The dispatch names a PANEL for that, and Parks is the precedent for a panel.

designDecisions.decision: the grouping dimension is drawn as COVERAGE, not as a matrix, and no operator-by-status cross-tab is drawn at all.
designDecisions.argument: Fire and EMS drew small multiples because its domain's own brief said a rollup could not answer the station question. Fleet's dimension cannot answer a condition question at all: operatorRef is assigned by 1 + ((seq - 1) % 4) over a severity-ordered plan, so the cross-tab is a stride. Measured: OPR-01 and OPR-02 carry 2 of 4 not-in-service, OPR-03 and OPR-04 carry 1 of 3, which tracks the 4/4/3/3 vehicle split exactly and is the modulo, not the fleet. Drawing it to refuse it still draws it, so it is stated in prose and not rendered.

designDecisions.decision: the three live-only roster columns render a declared token, never a blank cell.
designDecisions.argument: ENFORCEMENT, every record starts with its full shape: a missing column is invisible and an unaccounted cell is countable. Three of the eight shipped columns (DVIR, Safety 7d, Flags) can only fill from a granted feed, and web/app.js renders them blank on a generated pack through td()'s null-is-blank. A blank cell on a customer's screen reads as missing data about their fleet.

designDecisions.decision: the Connected board renders no invented live status values.
designDecisions.argument: src/vendor-live.mjs records that Samsara returns real data on 2026-09-03 but records none of the values. The cardinality and the labels of the real status set are UNESTABLISHED. The board draws the MECHANISM (the strip is rebuilt from the payload) and not a fake strip.

rejectedAlternatives: small multiples on the operator dimension, copying Fire and EMS. Rejected: it would manufacture a finding out of a round-robin and would import the readiness question into a dimension that cannot carry it.

a work-queue treatment (due, stage, age columns). Rejected at source: the domain states the shape is a flat roster with no place and no due date, and says the whole reason this domain is an exemplar is that it is not a queue.
drawing the cross-tab greyed out with a refusal caption. Rejected: a refused thing drawn is still drawn, and a reader takes the picture, not the caption.
a third board for the asset boundary. Rejected: it would repeat two basis lines Main already carries.

adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.observation: assertRecordShape refuses the live mapper's output.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.mechanismClaimed: the shape contract is starved on the live path: the guard exists, is correct, and the composer that produces real records never calls it.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.alternativeMechanism: the guard is deliberately uncalled because the module header rules that real status is kept as-is and never force-mapped, so calling it would force the mapping the product refuses.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.whyRejectedInPart: the alternative explains the STATUS fault and only that one. It does not explain operatorRef and odometerBand being required and absent, nor the 12 undeclared fields, and the header says nothing about either. The shape table's own preamble claims a fixture and a real record are the same shape, which the live record falsifies. The board states one of three faults as a declared position and two as undeclared.

adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.observation: three Connections register rows call Fleet Not built or Not connected while the region is registered and the grant is on bastrop_tx.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.mechanismClaimed: the disposition column is hand-declared and has no divergence test outside development-services, so it cannot be right or wrong per pack; it is a constant that has drifted.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.alternativeMechanism: the register is scoped to the demo pack, where template-city grants nothing, so the words are true of what the Connections page renders.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.whyRejected: shell-homes.mjs carries no pack field and nothing in its render path takes a pack, so there is no scoping for the alternative to rest on. The product's own test records the drift and routes it rather than editing it.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.disposition: README and report, not a board. It is a finding about the Connections surface and drawing it on the Fleet canvas would be designing another surface.

adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.observation: the page keeps two default sentences on a granted feed.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.mechanismClaimed: renderFleet only overwrites #fleet-roster-inventory and #fleet-operator-basis when extras.inventoryBasis and extras.operators[0] exist; the live extras carry neither, so the markup defaults stay and both read 'has not been read for this pack' about a region that WAS read.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.alternativeMechanism: the live payload might carry those extras through some other path.
adversarialReviewOfOwnFindings.whyRejected: okResult in vendor-live.mjs returns extras { realStatusCounts } and nothing else. There is one live composer for this domain and one call site.
